report.scope:
Evaluate frozen exact RCG leave-one-data-term-out signals; never change a mask.
Primary target: pixel-weighted TP versus FP inside actual RCG foreground.
Each64cell carries its exact1024pixel TP and FP counts, including mixed cells.
Conditional comparisons use same-episode10 fixed original-score bins; also z bins.
report.additional_control_provenance: Added after primary results as a necessary mechanism check, not preregistered: diagonal-only precision inverse h0=a/(a+16degree). Compare same residual divided by1-h0 against exact h normalization. No parameter/score orientation selected from GT.
report.direction: All scores are oriented larger=TP. loo-u is graph support relative to its own unary; z-u is the original smoothing residual with the same direction. negative_h treats high self influence as less supported. No orientation picked from GT.
report.identity_limit: The LOO term is conditional on all graph weights, confidence weights, ranks and other unaries being frozen. It is not an independent semantic observation. loo-u=(z-u)/(1-h), hence it never changes the residual sign.
